scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hello, I'm checking on the status of my housing loan application. Could you tell me if it has been approved, denied, or is still pending? Also, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved and originated. The loan product type is a Conventional:Subordinate Lien.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know. What is my interest rate and the total costs of this loan? Also, are there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 8.740%. The total costs of the loan are $241.32. This loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage and does not have negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: I see. What is my debt-to-income ratio, and how does that affect my application? Additionally, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio is 42%. This field is the ratio of your total monthly debt payments to your total monthly income. The record does not include underwriting rationale, so I cannot explain why this value was used in your application. Your loan has not been sold to another institution.

dialogue.user:
Understood. Thank you for the information. I think I have all the details I need.

<Neutral> The agent provided all the information I asked for clearly and politely, but I was hoping for a lower interest rate. The process was smooth, but the rate is higher than I expected.
